answer_1.quote: We carried out experiments on three different language pairs, including WAT17 English-Japanese (En-Jp), WMT14 English-German (En-De), and WMT17 Chinese-English (Zh-En)… The NMT model that we used in our experiments is Transformer.

answer_2.quote: We used BLEU to evaluate the NMT models. We used the TER toolkit to label whether the tokens in NMT outputs are correctly translated… Expected Calibration Error (ECE) is a commonly‑used metric to evaluate the miscalibration.
